# Tsh058 — Adjacent same-surface face merge ignores edge-preservation request

## Sources
- OCCT MANTIS#0028227

## Description

When same-surface face merging is invoked with a flag instructing it to preserve a specified set of edges, the algorithm processes the surrounding topology but still merges across the protected edges — typically because the flag is consulted at the top-level call site but not propagated into the inner edge-walker.

## Reproducer recipe

Two coplanar faces sharing an edge that is marked as "keep". Call unify with a list of edges to preserve. Resulting shape no longer contains the kept edge.

## Expected kernel behavior

edge-preservation flag must be honoured by every internal traversal; expose a list of "edges that survived" to confirm.

## Notes

**See also**: Tsh050. Defect manifests at runtime; fixture establishes the input precondition (two coplanar faces sharing edge E, with a property association marking E as `keep`).
